# These are test fixtures, not a copy of anyone's notebook

`notebook/` is input for the suite. It is **deliberately frozen**, and several of its entry names no
longer exist in the live notebook — `low-integrity-label-writes`, `https-only-openssl-tls` and
`git-push-piped-fails-in-sandbox` were later merged into one `sandbox-constraints.md` there, and
`tool-output-must-be-lossless-json` into `dsh-tool-definition-limits.md`.

**That divergence is intentional.** The suite asserts against these names, and a fixture that tracked
every reorganisation of someone's personal notes would need editing each time they tidied up. A fixture
that changes when the thing it tests does not is not a fixture.

## Rules

- **Add an entry when a rule needs one.** The tests in `test-core.mjs` name the entries they use; adding
  a case means adding the entry it needs.
- **Do not mirror the live notebook into this directory.** Copying it in would import names, ordering and
  phrasing that no test depends on, and every future tidy-up would break the build.
- **`INDEX.md` is generated by the plugin** during tests; edit it only to change the order a test
  depends on.
- **`notebook-policy.md` must stay byte-identical to `templates/notebook-policy.md`** — the fixture
  exercises the seeding path, and `scripts/check-docs.mjs` fails when the two copies drift.

## Where the real notebook is

Not in this repository. It lives wherever the plugin is configured to look — by default
`.agents/memory` under the session working directory — and it is the user's, not the project's.
